description.en: Treated the magnetic quantum number itself, in units of the field, as the energy shift, forgetting the Bohr magneton that actually converts it to an energy.
description.et: Käsitles magnetkvantarvu ennast, väljaühikutes, energianihkena, unustades Bohri magnetoni, mis selle tegelikult energiaks teisendab.

description.en: Used the electron's spin g-factor of about 2 instead of the orbital g-factor of 1 that applies to the normal Zeeman effect, doubling the splitting.
description.et: Kasutas elektroni spinni g-faktorit (umbes 2) selle asemel, mis kehtib orbitaal-g-faktori (1) kohta tavalise Zeemani efekti puhul, kahekordistades nihke.

description.en: Multiplied by the number of possible m states instead of the sampled state's own m value, overcounting the splitting for a single line.
description.et: Korrutas võimalike m-olekute arvuga, mitte valitud oleku enda m väärtusega, ülehinnates ühe joone nihet.
